name: P2: Purchase agreement out for signature

parameters.formDescription: Fill this in and the customer gets the agreement by DocuSign for signature. Demonstration build for the That's Automated portfolio.

values.formSubmittedText: Got it. The agreement is being generated and sent to the signer through DocuSign. Watch #leads in Slack for the envelope.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: { dealname: $json.agreement_number + " " + $json.company, amount: String($json.price), pipeline: "default", dealstage: "REPLACE_WITH_CONTACTED_STAGE_ID", description: "Purchase agreement " + $json.agreement_number + " sent to " + $json.signer_name + " <" + $json.signer_email + "> for signature." } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({}, $("Build agreement").item.json.envelope, { customFields: { textCustomFields: [ { name: "agreement_number", value: $("Build agreement").item.json.agreement_number, show: "false" }, { name: "hubspot_deal_id", value: String($json.id), show: "false" } ] } })) }}

parameters.text:
